serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Lady Annalie: Oh! Look who's here! Lady Annalie: How’s it going? You: Everything’s fine, more or less. Oh, right. I almost forgot. I was supposed to ask Annalie if she would be willing to help my neighbor. I’m still a little conflicted about this request, but as he said, guys need to help each other. We live in a nasty world… Besides, it’s not like I will force it on Annalie. If she doesn’t want to do it, oh well. My conscience will be clear knowing that I tried. You: I have a favor to ask. #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Damn, I kinda miss the time when you were coming here only to buy clothes. You have become such a bother! You: Come on, now. I still buy things from time to time. #Annalie.face.normal Lady Annalie: Sure buddy, whatever lets you sleep at night. You: You really are making it sound like I’m exploiting you or something… Lady Annalie: Oh, I have nothing against being exploited. #Annalie.face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: But in a quite different type of way~ You: … #Annalie.face.normal You: Sorry, not gonna happen. Lady Annalie: Wow, what a strong will! It only makes it more tempting~ You: Great, since it seems like you want some action my request shouldn’t be a problem. #Annalie.face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: Wha? Is it finally that kind of request? I don’t know if my heart is ready~ What is it? What is it?! #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: You see, my neighbor needs a little help. Lady Annalie: … #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: There’s a special place in hell for scum like you. How dare you play with a woman’s heart like that? #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: W-What do you mean?! It’s nothing weird, ok? You: Guy is legitimately heartbroken and asked me to set something up so that he can get his confidence back. #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised Lady Annalie: Hah? {{wi}}It sounds like a pain and not fun at all. Is he at least handsome or rich or have any other redeeming quality? You: No, I don’t think so. I wouldn’t know, I don’t know him that much. Lady Annalie: What? Why are you pushing some charity work on me here? Lady Annalie: No girl wants some sad, used-up-goods guy. #Annalie.face.sad You: It’s only one date, no strings attached. His spirits will go up and that’s it. Lady Annalie: Why me? Don’t you have any other female friends? #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Oh, right. It’s you we’re talking about here. Just forget I asked. You: … #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.normal Lady Annalie: What if he’s some creep? You: He didn’t seem like the type, but I chose a public place just to be sure. Lady Annalie: Wow, you thought about everything. You: I’m not going to force you. If you don’t wanna do it, don’t. #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: And now you are making it like I’m some evil woman that won’t help someone in need. Since when are you so manipulative? You: That wasn’t my intention at all. #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.normal Lady Annalie: Fine, I will do it, but you owe me a big one! #Annalie.face.normal You: A big one? Well, I don’t think I care that much about it… Lady Annalie: Whatever! I already made up my mind! You: Great! Here’s his number. Lady Annalie: Oh man… What a mess I got myself into… #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal You: Thanks, Annalie. You really are a good person. #Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.smile Lady Annalie: Was that even in question?! #Annalie.face.normal Lady Annalie: If I get killed by that guy, I’m going to haunt you. I promise you that. You: Please don’t. You: If you get in trouble give me a call, we will come to rescue you. Lady Annalie: That’s very reassuring. Lady Annalie: Now that I agreed to your outrageous request, how about actually buying something for once? You: Right…
